name: mob_create
arguments: uint16 mob_slot, uint16 picture, uint16 hpos, uint16 vpos, uint16 object_type, uint16 object_state
exceptional_convention: frameless; saves D2-D7/A2-A6 before reading six normal stack slots

name: moblist_insert
arguments: D1.w = doubled destination slot; A2-A6 = picture/H/V/link/state arrays

name: moblist_replace
exceptional_convention: frameless; saves D2-D7/A2-A6 before reading normal stack slots

name: moblist_remove
exceptional_convention: frameless wrapper; preserves object fields and clears only link indices; no discovered direct control site

name: move_mob_slot
arguments: D2.w = doubled source slot, D1.w = doubled destination slot; A2-A6 = picture/H/V/link/state arrays
exceptional_convention: register entry; falls through into moblist_remove_and_clear_regs

name: moblist_remove_and_clear_regs
arguments: D2.w = doubled mob slot; A2-A6 = picture/H/V/link/state arrays
exceptional_convention: register entry; unlinks and zeros all five slot words

name: moblist_unlink_regs
arguments: D2.w = doubled mob slot; A2-A6 = picture/H/V/link/state arrays
exceptional_convention: register entry; preserves object fields and upper link/state bits

name: mob_place_shot
exceptional_convention: tail-branches into shared saved-register body at 0x5DFA6; slot bias 0

name: mob_place_anim
exceptional_convention: tail-branches into shared saved-register body at 0x5DFA6; physical slot = channel + 0x11

name: mob_place_explosion
exceptional_convention: falls through into shared saved-register body at 0x5DFA6; physical slot = channel + 1

name: insert_mob_depth_sorted
arguments: D7.w = resolved physical slot; first wrapper stack argument at 0x22(A7) = uint16 depth_key
exceptional_convention: shared inherited saved-register body; exits through wrapper epilogue

name: mob_depth_remove
exceptional_convention: frameless normal-stack wrapper; resolves physical slot by adding 1
